title: AI-assisted game development: Here’s my multiplayer game so far
author: drunkdogpeeing
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’m making a multiplayer indie game called **Galactic Mayhem**

It’s a chaotic multiplayer arena game where up to 4 players battle each other using 32 unique weapons, special abilities, environmental hazards, and a variety of arenas. The goal is basically to throw as much controlled chaos at the player as possible. 😂

What makes this project especially interesting to me is how heavily I’ve been using AI throughout the development process.

I’ve been using AI as a development partner for things like:

* Gameplay debugging
* Problem solving
* Prototyping
* Iterating on features and systems

Full Trailer:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d6ZFaB92TaQ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d6ZFaB92TaQ)

I'm curious to hear from other developers who are doing something similar:

**How are you using AI in your game development workflow?**

Are you using it primarily for coding, art, design, debugging, Unreal/Unity assistance, or are you basically using it as an AI development partner like I am?

I'd also really appreciate any feedback on the game itself. This is an indie project and I'm trying to improve it as much as possible before release.

🎮 **Galactic Mayhem on Steam:**  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5121060/Galactic\_Mayhem/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5121060/Galactic_Mayhem/)

Thanks for checking it out, and I'd love to hear what other AI-assisted developers are working on!
